name: Is this text a scam?

ask.instructions: What is this text message mainly about?

criteria.personal: Friends or family chatting, making plans, or sharing news.
criteria.money_request: Asks the reader to send money, gift cards, crypto, a wire or a payment app transfer.
criteria.account_alert: Says there is a problem with a bank, card, government, Medicare or shopping account.
criteria.delivery: About a package, shipment or delivery.
criteria.prize: Says the reader won something, is owed a refund, or has a reward to claim.
criteria.service: A normal reminder or notice from a pharmacy, doctor, store or utility.

ask.instructions: Does the sender claim to be family or a friend who is suddenly in trouble or using a new number?

criteria.true: Says they are a relative or friend in an emergency, in jail, hurt, stranded, or texting from a new phone.
criteria.false: Ordinary conversation with someone the reader knows.

ask.instructions: Does the message ask the reader to tap a link, call a number, reply with a code, or give account details?

criteria.true: Contains a link to tap, a number to call, or asks for a code, password, card or account details.
criteria.false: Only informs; nothing to tap, call or send.

ask.instructions: Does the message contain a web link that is not the company's real website?

criteria.true: A link with a misspelled, extra-worded or unusual address, like usps-redelivery.co or chase-secure-login.net.
criteria.false: No link at all, or only the company's normal website address.

ask.instructions: How hard does the message push the reader to act right now?
criteria: Extreme: threats, secrecy, an emergency or a countdown.

ask.instructions: Does it ask for money, gift cards, codes, passwords or personal details?

criteria.true: Asks for money, gift cards, crypto, one-time codes, passwords, Social Security or account numbers.
criteria.false: Does not ask for money or private details.

safe.label: Looks fine
safe.say: Nothing here looks like a trick.

careful.label: Be careful
careful.say: Don't tap or reply yet. Check with someone you trust first.

scam.label: Looks like a scam
scam.say: Don't reply, don't tap links, don't send anything.

examples.title: Grandkid needs bail money
examples.text: Hi Grandma, it's me. I'm in trouble and need $2,000 for bail. Please don't tell Mom. Can you buy Target gift cards and send me the codes?

examples.title: Package on hold, tap link
examples.text: USPS: Your package is on hold due to an incomplete address. Update within 12 hours: usps-redelivery.co/track

examples.title: Dinner on Sunday?
examples.text: Hey Mom, are we still on for dinner Sunday? I'll bring the pie.

examples.title: Bank fraud alert
examples.text: Chase Fraud Alert: Did you attempt a $689.00 purchase at Walmart? Reply YES or NO.

examples.title: You won a gift card
examples.text: Congratulations! You've won a $1,000 Walmart gift card. Claim it now before it expires.

examples.title: Prescription ready
examples.text: Your prescription is ready for pickup at CVS Pharmacy on Main St. Open until 9pm.

description: Reads a text message and decides, one small question at a time, whether it's a scam.
